--- attachments/protocol/contract_migration_profile.txt ---
GEELY PLUG & CHARGE CONTRACT MIGRATION PROFILE / CP 9.2

The station verifies the vehicle contract certificate to the Geely PlugCharge
Root CA. Contract signatures are ECDSA P-256 over the exact ASCII TBS document;
the signature encoding is r||s, not DER.

A historical authorization may be submitted when all of the following hold:
  action                  MIGRATE
  vehicle_status          PARKED_CONNECTED
  v2g_state               SESSION_ESTABLISHED
  signature               valid for the contract certificate
  contract certificate    valid at the original authorization time

The new station uses the same ECDSA verifier, but it does not rebuild a schema
v001 document. It checks only the signed fields that exist in that document.
Missing optional fields are handled by compatibility defaults:
  max_current_a        -> 250
  price_plan           -> PUBLIC_UNMETERED
  authorization_scope  -> PnC-START-MAINTENANCE

The compatibility defaults are treated as configuration, not as signed data.

Migration acceptance code:
  CODE = SHA-256(
      SHA-256(DER(vehicle contract certificate)) ||
      SHA-256(exact TBS of the accepted historical record) ||
      ASCII("PNC-DOWNGRADE-ACCEPTED") ||
      ASCII("max_current_a=250") ||
      ASCII("authorization_scope=PnC-START-MAINTENANCE")
  )

Flag encoding:
  FLAG = GEELY{PNC_<first 24 lowercase hex of CODE>_<last 24 lowercase hex of CODE>}

CTF challenge statement (Chinese), 2026 Zeekr Cybersecurity Quals (CTF-Archives public dump). Statement:

某运营平台把一台车辆的历史 Plug & Charge 授权记录同步到了新型充电桩。新桩仍允许提交 `schema v001` 的历史迁移授权，以支持跨代车辆迁移。
安全审计发现，桩端能正确验证历史签名，但兼容层在文档缺少可选约束字段时使用固定默认值。现在需要确认这些默认值是否会被当成已授权配置。
flag 格式 GEELY{PNC_............}
